description: A report script for generating a subcontract order summary in ERPNext, involving data retrieval and processing of purchase orders and supplied items.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, returning columns and data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and processes data for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_subcontracted_orders
methods.description: Fetches purchase orders that are subcontracted within the specified date range and filters.

methods.name: get_filters
methods.description: Builds filter criteria for querying purchase orders.

methods.name: get_supplied_items
methods.description: Retrieves supplied items related to the orders.

methods.name: prepare_subcontracted_data
methods.description: Prepares detailed data combining orders and supplied items.

methods.name: get_subcontracted_data
methods.description: Populates the report data list with combined order and supplied item details.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.
